tasks.title: Write an Email
tasks.instruction: Write an email. In your email, do the following:
tasks.prompt: You are a student leader at your school and have been assigned to help plan your class field trip. You have found a travel agency that offers comprehensive travel packages and want to contact the travel agent, Mr. Brown, to inquire about their services. Write an email to the travel agent, Mr. Brown.
bullets: Explain the purpose and dates of the class field trip.
Ask about the available offers for large groups.
Request details on how they can accommodate specific travel needs and additional services offered.
tasks.subject: Inquiry About Class Field Trip Travel Packages
